markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (64%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Stain-degraded frozen section cannot separate Invasive (64%) from InSitu (35%); defer margins and order recut/deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 64%, InSitu 35%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%) [F1] | Invasive favored; InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot exclude InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 98th OOD percentile (AUROC 0.70) [F6] | Stain-degraded suspect input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models conflict |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive (60%), 2/5 InSitu; top BACH_0160 InSitu (85%) [F5] | Split Invasive vs InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.38, +0.80); unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.77, +0.70), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.10, +0.47); 20/20 AI spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · High (+1.62, +0.31); unreliable 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(Invasive) 0.0114 vs random (CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3, 98th OOD percentile, 10 regions) distorted embeddings and triggered CONCH–MUSK disagreement.
- Lesion is InSitu (35%, in conformal set), matching top neighbor BACH_0160 (85%) on pleomorphism/lymphocytes.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 8, 3**: Highest risk (91%, 57%, 49%); verify stromal invasion versus stain artifact.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 10**: Compare duct-confined atypia (2, 3) against validated invasion/pleomorphism (10).
3. **Region 7**: Check residual lobules, tubules, stroma; defer frozen margins [F7] and order recut/deeper levels.
